title: Lead/Senior Security System Engineer - Network Cloud
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Lead/Senior Security System Engineer** to design, implement, and operate secure, compliant network segmentation between regional environments and Global networks, using a standardised control stack of Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Cloudflare for DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application protection. This role blends architecture, hands-on engineering, automation, and L3/L4 operational leadership to deliver policy-driven connectivity under strict regulatory and operational requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Define trust zones, routing boundaries, and inter-zone controls for regional and Global Network, covering north-south and east-west paths, micro-segmentation for sensitive tiers, and explicit cross-border allow-lists
* Produce HLD/LLD, threat models, and control mappings aligned to internal standards and regional regulation to enable secure communication
* Design and operate dual-vendor firewall perimeters, with clear control allocation, HA/cluster design, deterministic failover, NAT domain strategy, and SSL/TLS inspection governance tuned for jurisdiction
* Engineer ZIA for identity-aware egress controls, SSL inspection with jurisdiction-aware bypasses, inline CASB/DLP, and sanctioned SaaS governance
* Implement ZPA for per-application zero-trust access, with connector placement, posture checks, conditional access, and app segmentation replacing legacy VPN where feasible
* Design and deliver Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect/Partner Interconnect equivalents, and dual-tunnel HA per site with BGP for failover between on-prem and hub VPC
* Deploy Cloudflare Magic Transit/Magic WAN, WAF Management, and rate limiting for internet-facing services, with layered defence integration with on-prem perimeters
* Engineer SD-WAN/MPLS/SASE paths with policy-based routing, strong encryption, and defined key custody/rotation by jurisdiction
* Translate regulatory and internal control requirements into enforceable technical controls for logging, data residency, TLS inspection scope, and lawful intercept considerations
* Normalise telemetry from security platforms into SIEM with regional data handling rules, and build detections for cross-border anomalies, DDoS events, and policy drift
* Lead L3/L4 incidents, coordinate issue containment, and drive RCAs with corrective actions codified
* Manage firewall, Zscaler, and Cloudflare policy through automation tools and vendor APIs, with CI/CD implementation including policy linting, unit tests, and path simulation

**Requirements**

* 6-15 years of overall IT experience, with a strong background in network security architecture and engineering
* Expertise in Check Point Security Gateways, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, and firewall cluster/HA design
* Proficiency in Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access for zero-trust and identity-aware access control
* Knowledge of Cloudflare Magic Transit, Magic WAN, and WAF for DDoS mitigation and application protection
* Familiarity with cloud hybrid connectivity, including Site-to-Site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, and BGP routing
* Understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, and SASE architectures with policy-based routing and strong encryption protocols
* Skills in Microsoft Sentinel and SIEM platforms for telemetry normalisation, detection engineering, and incident response
* Competency in automation and policy-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, and vendor REST APIs
* Qualifications in regulatory compliance and audit readiness, including control matrices and CIS Benchmarks

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Laboratory Engineer
description:
**Be part of something bigger!**
--------------------------------

  

As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it’s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy.

  

As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and € 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world!

  

**Purpose and Mission**
-----------------------

**BITC Laboratory Technical Leadership, Operations & Capability Development**

* BITC Laboratory comprises Static & Fatigue Testing, Adhesion Testing, Material Characterization and Tyre Forensic Analysis capabilities supporting product development, customer requirements and technical problem solving across steel cords, filaments, tyre components and other technical samples.
* The role provides technical leadership for laboratory operations and capability development, ensuring timely and reliable testing, sound interpretation of results and technically robust conclusions. The position is responsible for building laboratory expertise, developing and improving test methods, identifying trends and failure mechanisms, and strengthening laboratory capabilities to support product and technology development. The role also develops team capability and ensures high standards of safety, quality and continuous improvement.

**Key Activities and Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

**Lab Management & QMS Implementation**

* Develop and communicate the laboratory strategic roadmap, including capability development, infrastructure and investment priorities, and future growth requirements.
* Establish, implement and maintain laboratory processes in line with the Quality Management System (QMS) and Environmental Management System (EMS) requirements.
* Contribute to BITC and laboratory scorecards by ensuring reliable, timely and high-quality test delivery, while building the pipeline of future testing and capability requirements.
* Analyze and interpret laboratory test results, correlate findings with material/product behavior and failure mechanisms, and provide technically sound conclusions and recommendations for product development and problem solving.
* Drive continuous improvement in laboratory processes, methods and performance using structured approaches such as PDCA and Six Sigma.
* Plan and execute laboratory audits and MRMs, ensuring timely closure of actions and compliance with quality standards.
* Build team competency through training, knowledge sharing and performance dialogues, fostering a culture of safety, quality, collaboration and technical excellence.
* Oversee equipment calibration and verification, and drive the development, validation and standardization of test methods.
  

**Product & Application Technical Expertise**

* Develop and strengthen technical knowledge of steel cord applications in tyres, including product performance and application requirements.
* Contribute to technical and innovation projects that generate insights for new product and technology development, while independently leading assigned sub-projects from planning through execution.
* Support customer projects by developing relevant testing capabilities and new test methods, translating customer requirements into robust technical approaches and actionable test results.
  

**Core Expertise & Lab Projects**

* Develop and maintain specialized technical expertise in Mechanical Testing, Adhesion Testing, Material Characterization, and Tyre Forensics establishing these as core laboratory competencies.
* Build in-depth knowledge in selected technical domains through literature reviews, market and technology research, technical conferences and engagement with external technical networks.
* Independently lead assigned sub-projects related to technical development, problem solving, core laboratory expertise and test method development, from planning and execution through analysis and technical conclusions.

**Essential Skills & Competencies**
-----------------------------------

**Must Have**

* Master’s degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline
* Minimum 5 years of experience in an R&D environment, with demonstrated expertise in laboratory testing and capability development
* Strong logical, analytical and data interpretation skills
* Structured and systematic approach to technical problem solving
* Good command of English, both written and spoken
* Strong sense of ownership and responsibility, with the ability to work independently and effectively within a team
* Strong interest in technical investigation, experimentation and research-oriented work
  

**Prefer to have**

* Experience in laboratory management, technical team supervision and capability building
* Strong knowledge of mechanical testing and fundamental principles of mechanics
* Experience in developing or improving testing methods, processes and laboratory capabilities
* Broad technical interests and willingness to explore emerging testing techniques and technologies

**Authorization**
-----------------

* Prioritize and schedule laboratory testing activities based on project, customer and business requirements.
* Define and approve laboratory test methods, testing approaches and technical conclusions within the scope of the role.
* Recommend and initiate improvements to laboratory processes, methods, equipment and capabilities.
* Allocate laboratory resources and assign work to technicians and analysts to ensure timely execution.
* Identify laboratory capability, equipment and investment requirements and recommend priorities to the Head of BITC.
* Stop or escalate testing activities where safety, quality, equipment reliability or test-result integrity is at risk.

**Be bold and take the leap!**
------------------------------

  

We're looking for individuals who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas. If you are passionate about personal growth and bringing your authentic self to work, we want you on our team!
  
At Bekaert, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
To learn more about us and our exciting career opportunities, visit Bekaert Careers

title: Controls Engineer, Controls Deployment & Service India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination.  
  
As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.  
  
To be successful in this team, you will also have:
  

* Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
* Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

  
Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)  

* Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
* Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
* Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

  
A day in the life  

* Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

  
About the team  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of critical data center equipment
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Control System Engineer
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**Purpose :** We are seeking an experienced Process Control Engineer with deep expertise in materials handling automation, constraint control, and throughput optimisation, capable of translating plant operating objectives into robust control strategies that consistently maximise production while maintaining stable and safe operation. Experience in large-scale mining operations would be highly advantageous.
  
  
The role is responsible for the design, implementation, tuning, and continuous improvement of constraint-based control strategies that maximise plant throughput while maintaining stable and safe operation. The role focuses on coordinating process control systems across the entire materials handling and processing circuit, ensuring production rates are optimised without causing equipment overload, blockages, or spillage.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong advanced process control, automation, and optimisation experience with expertise in bulk materials handling systems. They will have demonstrated capability in developing and commissioning constraint-based control strategies, analysing process performance, and delivering plant-wide throughput improvements through effective application of control theory, process modelling, and data-driven optimisation techniques.
  
  
To design, review, and deliver secure and resilient OT network architectures and engineering solutions that support industrial control systems, telecommunications infrastructure, digital platforms, and production-critical operational services.
  
  
The role ensures that OT network designs are aligned with client requirements, engineering standards, cybersecurity principles, industrial protocols, operational performance expectations, and project delivery objectives.
  
  
**The Role**

***As a Senior Control System Engineer with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

* Design and implement plant-wide constraint control strategies.
* Develop, configure, and commission advanced process control algorithms.
* Optimise materials handling systems to maximise throughput and minimise operational disturbances.
* Coordinate interactions between multiple process areas and control systems.
* Configure and tune PLC/DCS regulatory and supervisory control loops.
* Analyse process data to identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop process simulations and material flow models to validate control strategies.
* Support commissioning, performance testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Work closely with operations personnel to establish and maintain production targets.  

**About You**  
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  
**Job Specific Skills:**

* Advanced Process Control & Optimisation:
  + Constraint Control Strategy (CCS) design, implementation, and optimisation
  + Advanced Process Control (APC) methodologies
  + Plant-wide throughput optimisation
  + Bottleneck and constraint identification
  + Push-pull control philosophies
  + Production rate optimisation and load balancing
  + Regulatory and supervisory control systems
  + Process performance monitoring and continuous improvement
* Process Control Engineering:
  + Process dynamics and control theory
  + PID control loop design, tuning, and optimisation
  + Model-based control strategies
  + Control system stability analysis
  + Process commissioning and performance testing
  + Statistical Process Control (SPC)
  + Control narrative and functional specification development
  + Alarm management and control system diagnostics
* Materials Handling Systems:
  + Conveyor systems control
  + Crusher, screen, stockpile, and reclaim systems
  + Ore handling facilities and process plants
  + Weightometer-based flow control
  + Bulk materials flow optimisation
  + Throughput and inventory management
  + Overload and spillage prevention strategies
  + Route and equipment coordination
* Control Systems & Automation:
  + PLC programming, configuration, and troubleshooting
  + DCS configuration and optimisation
  + ABB 800xA (highly desirable)
  + SCADA systems
  + Industrial communications and interfaces
  + Control system testing and commissioning
  + Functional design specifications (FDS)
  + Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)
* Process Simulation & Analytics:
  + Process modelling and simulation
  + Material flow modelling
  + MATLAB/Simulink (desirable)
  + Data analysis and visualisation
  + Historian data interpretation
  + Performance analytics and KPI development
  + Production forecasting and scenario analysis
  + Root cause analysis
* Instrumentation:
  + Flow, level, pressure, and weight measurement systems
  + Weightometer calibration and utilisation
  + Process instrumentation selection and application
  + Instrument loop testing
  + Field commissioning and troubleshooting
  + Instrument reliability and maintenance considerations
* Mining & Industry Knowledge:
  + Iron ore processing and materials handling
  + Mining process plants
  + Production management principles
  + Safe and sustainable operations
  + Asset utilisation and operational excellence
  + Brownfield optimisation projects

**Qualifications / Requirements:**  
**Essential:**

* Bachelor degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Control Systems, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years' experience in process control and automation.
* Strong background in bulk materials handling and plant-wide optimisation.
* Demonstrated experience with Advanced Process Control (APC) and constraint control strategies.
* Strong understanding of process dynamics, instrumentation, and control theory.
* Experience in data analytics and statistical process control.
* Proficiency in PLC and DCS configuration, programming, testing, and commissioning.
* Experience tuning control loops and improving process control algorithms.
* Ability to analyse process bottlenecks and optimise production systems.

**Preferred:**

* Iron ore processing and materials handling experience.
* ABB 800xA experience.
* MATLAB modelling and simulation experience.
* Mining conveyor, crushing, screening, stockyard, and reclaim systems experience.
* Plant-wide throughput optimisation and load-shedding strategies.

**Typical Technologies:**

* ABB 800xA
* PLC platforms (ABB, Rockwell, Siemens, Schneider)
* Advanced Process Control (APC)
* MATLAB/Simulink
* Weightometers and process instrumentation
* Historian and analytics systems
* Conveyor and materials handling control systems

**Other Attributes:**

* Highly organised, reliable, practical, and delivery-focused.
* Able to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and maintain accuracy and attention to detail in operationally critical environments.
* Strong relationship-building skills with clients, vendors, peers, senior management, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Able to protect sensitive, proprietary, and security-related information.
* Proactive, service-minded, collaborative, and willing to challenge assumptions constructively to improve technical outcomes.
Committed to quality, safety, operational reliability, and Worley values.  

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Requisition Number: 79131

**The company built on breakthroughs.**  
**Join us.**

Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.

How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.

At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.

Come break through with us.

  

Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.

  

**Function/Dept Purpose Statement**

The Plant Engineering organization is the steward of our equipment and process. We maintain the equipment; conduct advanced troubleshooting; monitor equipment and process performance; and develop and implement process/equipment/procedure adjustments.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Supports drive to fundamental process understanding and lowest cost producer objectives.
* Supports the development and execution of plans to evaluate improvements in existing technology resulting in a superior product in terms of quality and/or cost.
* Supports and/or leads sub-teams on new equipment installation, process certification, documentation and training.
* Works with other team members to solve difficult technical, engineering related problems.
* Supports or leads small project teams to focus on continuous improvement activities, new product or process introductions, and cost reduction projects.
* Executes cost reduction and improvement (DMAIC) projects in line with business objectives.
* Trains operators and trades personnel on new equipment and processes.
* Troubleshoots material, process and equipment issues, identifies root cause and implements corrective action.
* Implements and documents material, process and/or equipment changes.
* Identifies and supports evaluation of equipment, process and cost-improvement opportunities for upcoming projects.
* Assists in developing preliminary project scope, technical requirements, cost estimates, and justification for equipment or process-improvement projects.

  

***Project state***

* Training program will be “on the job” and will be results oriented, practical training.
* During training program, assists with the installation, start-up, troubleshooting, and operation of manufacturing equipment and learns our safety protocol, equipment, process, and culture/values.
* Leverages training program to assist in the installation, start-up, debugging, and operationalization of our process equipment in the Indian GF.
* Works with other team members to ensure quality operations are occurring.
* Validates training and other installation/process support processes and helps to train new personnel.
* Supports the review of engineering drawings, equipment layouts, installation and commissioning documents.
* Coordinates installation readiness, including site access, utility availability, contractor mobilization, material availability and safety requirements.
* Oversees and coordinates on-site activities for the installation, start-up, troubleshooting and commissioning of equipment and related systems
* Maintains project schedules, milestone plans, action trackers, and periodic progress/status reports.
* Tracks project risks, issues, dependencies and roadblocks; escalate potential impact on scope, schedule, cost or quality.
* Supports in equipment acceptance, performance trials, and handover to operations and maintenance.

**Required Experience:**

* 4-7 years’ experience in process engineering Projects in manufacturing environment
* Exposure to industrial safety practices
* Demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing multiple tasks and issues effectively

**Required Knowledge:**

* B.E. in Mechanical/Mechatronics
* Experience in Project Management/Project Execution
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong Data Analysis skills (Control Charts, Pareto Analysis, Pivot Table) and Analytical mindset
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and/or as a team leader
* Technical aptitude conducive to building proficiency in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment and evaluating manufacturing data.
* Experience with MS-office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and MS Access.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or DMAIC project experience preferred
* Basic understanding of project scheduling, project documentation, action/risk tracking, and progress reporting.
* Familiarity with MS Project or other project-planning/tracking tools is preferred.

title: AI Principle Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

AI Principle ArchitectMastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by delivering unparalleled data-driven intelligence and cutting-edge AI solutions. By harnessing proprietary data, frontier generative AI, and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, faster, and more impactful decisions. We transform complex, multi-modal data into agentic systems and generative applications that drive measurable business outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.  
We're looking for a Principal Architect, Generative AI & ML Engineering, for the Operational Intelligence Program within B&MI. As a principal-level technical leader, you'll define the architecture vision and technical strategy for our agentic AI platform. On this platform, agents make extensive tool calls into enterprise services and APIs and must run securely, reliably, and at scale. You'll set the standards teams build on across tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, self-correcting agents, memory, retrieval, and LLMOps. You'll also make the key decisions on models, platforms, and trade-offs. Working closely with engineering, product, security, and business leaders, you'll shape the long-term direction of Gen AI across B&MI and mentor architects and senior engineers. You'll also stay hands-on with prototypes that de-risk big bets. The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale. If you've solved them as a backend or distributed systems architect and have started applying that experience to LLM systems, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities  

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for the Operational Intelligence Gen AI platform, defining reference architectures and standards that teams across the program can reuse and scale.
* Architect the enterprise tool-calling layer, setting standards for how internal services, data platforms, and external APIs are exposed to agents as tools. This covers schemas, contracts, versioning, access control, and resilient execution (parallel and chained calls, retries, timeouts, idempotency, circuit breakers, and fallbacks).
* Set the architecture for multi-agent and skills-based agent systems (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen), including when to use agents versus deterministic workflows and how agents coordinate, delegate, and share context.
* Design self-correcting agent patterns: tool critics and verifiers that check tool selection, arguments, and results, plus reflection and plan-and-execute loops that catch errors before agents act or respond.
* Architect agent memory and state for long-running, multi-step sessions, including short- and long-term memory (e.g., Mem0, Zep, LangGraph memory), session persistence, and memory scoping and retention.
* Define retrieval architecture for grounded reasoning, including Self-RAG, Corrective RAG (CRAG), adaptive retrieval, and Graph-RAG, built on vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch) and knowledge graphs (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune).
* Design the inference and orchestration layer for high throughput, covering async processing, streaming, caching, rate limiting, and model routing across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and open-source models.
* Establish the LLMOps architecture on Databricks (AWS), including MLflow, CI/CD for prompts and agents, and model lineage. Set platform-wide evaluation and observability standards: end-to-end tracing of tool calls, tool-selection accuracy, task success rates, cost, and latency.
* Build security and Responsible AI into the architecture, including guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and audit trails that meet Mastercard's data ethics and regulatory standards.
* Own key architecture decisions and trade-offs, such as build versus buy, model and vendor selection, and cost versus latency versus accuracy, documented through architecture decision records. Assess emerging models, frameworks, and standards such as MCP for production readiness.
* Lead design reviews and partner with engineering, product, security, and data teams to align on architecture and raise the engineering bar across the program.
* Stay hands-on, building prototypes and reference implementations that de-risk decisions and give teams a working starting point.

All About You  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant experience architecting large-scale distributed systems in production, including microservices, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native infrastructure.
* Deep expertise in API design and systems integration, including contracts, security models, and reliability patterns for services consumed by many teams. You understand what changes when the consumer is an LLM.
* Hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered systems in production, especially agents that use tool/function calling, memory, and retrieval, and a clear view of how they fail.
* Strong Python skills for hands-on prototyping (async programming, FastAPI or similar), plus SQL proficiency.
* Deep experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP welcome), including its AI services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, or Vertex AI.
* A solid grounding in security, privacy, and compliance for enterprise systems, ideally in financial services or another regulated industry.
* The ability to influence without authority, aligning engineering, product, and leadership around a technical direction and explaining trade-offs in business terms.
* Nice to have: hands-on experience with tool critics, Self-RAG, CRAG, reflection loops, memory frameworks such as Mem0 or Zep, MCP tool servers, or agent evaluation frameworks.
* Nice to have: exposure to fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT, RLHF), multimodal models, or knowledge graphs.
* Coming from backend or distributed systems architecture? The hardest problems in enterprise Gen AI are reliability, integration, security, and scale, and you've solved them before. If you've started applying that experience to LLM systems, we want to hear from you, even if you haven't used every tool listed here.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals, routing and switching technologies, network security, and troubleshooting methodologies.

* **User Support:** Provide technical assistance for network-related problems and ensure timely resolution of service requests.

Qualifications and Experience

* **Educational Qualification:** Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Relevant experience in network administration, network engineering, or IT infrastructure support is preferred.
* **Networking Knowledge:** Strong understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, and network connectivity.
* **Routing and Switching:** Familiarity with network routing protocols, switching technologies, VLANs, and network configuration.
* **Network Security:** Basic knowledge of firewall configuration, access control, and network security principles.
* **Troubleshooting Skills:** Ability to diagnose and resolve network connectivity and performance issues systematically.
* **Monitoring Tools:** Familiarity with network monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* **Communication Skills:** Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.

Required Skills

TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Routing, Switching, Firewalls, Network Troubleshooting, Network Monitoring, Network Configuration, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, Network Security, Infrastructure Maintenance, Incident Management, Technical Documentation, IT Support, and Problem-Solving.

The ideal candidate should possess a solid understanding of networking concepts, hands-on knowledge of network infrastructure, and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently.

Candidates should be proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to maintaining network reliability, security, and performance. The ability to work collaboratively with IT support teams and maintain accurate technical documentation is essential.

title: Agentic AI Lead - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced Agentic AI Lead to drive the design, development and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI solutions across Vodafone’s Corporate AI Portfolio. This role will play a key part in shaping the future of AskHR, Vodafone’s AI-powered HR assistant, by defining agent architectures, advancing multi-agent orchestration across Google Cloud and Microsoft Copilot ecosystems, and creating reusable AI patterns for broader corporate functions. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on engineering leadership, enabling the delivery of secure, scalable and high-quality AI experiences that enhance employee productivity and experience globally.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

### **Agentic AI Engineering**

* Design, develop and deploy production-grade agentic AI solutions, ranging from single-agent implementations to complex multi-agent systems.
* Implement advanced capabilities including tool and function calling, planning, memory management and agent orchestration.
* Apply emerging interoperability standards such as Agent2Agent (A2A) and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

### **Architecture & Knowledge Management**

* Evolve the AskHR AI architecture across Vertex AI Agent Builder, Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Engine and Gemini, integrating seamlessly with Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Drive improvements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), grounding quality, chunking strategies, metadata filtering and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* Lead the transition from structured workflow-driven experiences to conversational, agent-led interactions.

### **Quality, Security & Operations**

* Establish robust evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, regression testing and conversation analytics.
* Implement observability frameworks, performance monitoring and cost optimisation strategies.
* Embed responsible AI principles, privacy-by-design practices, GDPR compliance, prompt-injection protection and enterprise security controls.
* Define and implement LLMOps practices and CI/CD processes for prompts, agents and knowledge pipelines.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Mentor and support engineers across multiple squads through code reviews, technical guidance and engineering standards.
* Collaborate with architects, conversation designers, product owners and business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business objectives.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and industry developments.

### **Initial Focus Areas**

* Define and secure adoption of a target agentic architecture across HR, Google Cloud, Copilot Studio and SAP platforms.
* Accelerate onboarding of HR journeys and knowledge sources through improved ingestion capabilities.
* Deliver scalable content ingestion pipelines that significantly reduce onboarding time for new data sources.
* Introduce evaluation-led release processes that improve answer quality and user containment rates.
* Prototype innovative employee experiences and contribute to the FY28 AI roadmap.

### **Broader Business Impact**

* Develop reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference architectures for HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal and other corporate domains.
* Provide technical leadership across expanding AI portfolios and support the scaling of successful AI solutions throughout the organisation.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Essential Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in senior software engineering, machine learning engineering or AI platform development, typically gained over 8+ years.
* Proven hands-on experience delivering production-scale generative AI, LLM and agentic AI solutions.
* Strong programming expertise in Python, with TypeScript experience considered advantageous.
* Deep expertise in either Google Cloud AI technologies (Vertex AI, Agent Builder, ADK, Gemini) or Microsoft AI technologies (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework), alongside working knowledge of the alternative ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, API design and enterprise integrations.
* Experience with cloud-native development, including containers, serverless platforms, infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices.
* Expertise in AI evaluation methodologies, observability platforms and production AI monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and supporting the growth of engineering talent.

### **Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Experience delivering AI solutions within HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement or other corporate functions.
* Knowledge of SAP integrations, including SAP SuccessFactors and SAP BTP.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow platforms.
* Exposure to multilingual conversational AI solutions, regulated environments and global deployments.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

title: Senior SIEM Engineer
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our Securonix Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by Securonix EON’s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats.

Recognized as a five-time leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM and highly rated on Gartner Peer Insights, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR) experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.

Securonix is proud to be a cybersecurity unicorn and featured in CRN's 2024 Security 100 list. Backed by Vista Equity Partners, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than 1,000 customers  
worldwide, including 10% of the Fortune 100. Our network of 150+ partners and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:

  

* Winning as One Team: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes
* Customer Driven Innovation: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers
* Agility in Action: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change

  

Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.

**Role Summary:**

The Senior SIEM Engineer position is an integral part of our Professional Services team. In this role, you will work with our customers , supporting our mission to help them quickly and completely adopt our Security Operating Platform, leaving them more secure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that will focus on architecting, planning, implementing, and operationalizing the SIEM platform. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of information security and networking and extensive experience interacting with customers. Securonix Next-Gen SIEM and UEBA experience, although desired, is not required, but the candidate must have SIEM and SOAR software expertise and be willing to train on the Securonix platform and products.

**Primary Responsibility:**

  

* Lead end-to-end SIEM implementation or integrations in a customer environment.
* Understand customer business requirements and the threat landscape applicable to their industry’s vertical sector to develop tailored use cases for security and Incident monitoring.
* Coordinate with customers to deploy collectors and agents in the on-premises network for data collection and forwarding.
* Work with customers to design and implement secure data flow into the Securonix cloud, following industry-standard best practices.
* Coordinate with service delivery managers, management, engineering, maintenance, and operational support teams to ensure timely delivery.
* Develop content, use cases, data models, dashboards, and connectors to support custom user requirements.
* Troubleshooting end-to-end network and infrastructure issues during data onboarding.
* Deploy and integrate the Securonix SOAR solution with the customer infrastructure for response orchestration.
* Engage with customers and internal product development teams to gather user requirements, suggest new product features, and help improve existing ones.
* Training and enabling customers and partners for successful adoption.

  

**Minimum Requirements:**

  

* 8+ years of experience in information security and SIEM field.
* Strong understanding of SIEM solutions such as Splunk, Qradar, ArcSight, Logrhythm and Exabeam.
* Experience deploying SIEM acorss multiple customers.
* Good understanding of MITRE ATT&CK matrices, kill chains and other attack models.
* Strong communication skills and customer facing experience.
* Strong knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, Powershell.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM

  

**Preferred:**

  

* BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, CyberSecurity
* 3-4+ years of experience in UEBA deployment
* Working knowledge of Machine learning in cybersecurity
* Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as Amazon, Azure and Google
* Good understanding of log collection methodologies and aggregation techniques such as Syslog-NG, syslog, Nxlog, Windows Event Forwarding
* Good understanding of Hadoop ecosystem and Apache technologies.
* Experience integrating endpoint security and host-based intrusion detection solutions
* Experience with network forensics and toolsets such as Wireshark, PCAP, tcpdump

  

**Benefits:**

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:

  

* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000

title: Infrastructure Engineer II – eApps
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

• **Support, maintain, and improve** third-party Enterprise Applications infrastructure through platform operations, administration, automation, monitoring, and cross-team delivery.

• **Own assigned operational activities with increasing independence** while following approved standards and partnering with senior engineers on complex issues, platform improvements, and project delivery.

• **Contribute to Infrastructure as Code and automation** using Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, and PowerShell to improve repeatability, reliability, and support efficiency.

• **Work closely with senior team members, infrastructure teams, application stakeholders, and vendors** to deliver stable services and build technical capability across E-Apps operations.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• **Platform operations:** Support the health, availability, administration, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned E-Apps platforms.

• **Administration and maintenance:** Perform platform configuration, patching, upgrades, certificate updates, service management, access changes, backup checks, and routine maintenance across Windows and Linux environments.

• **Web and application platforms:** Administer and troubleshoot IIS, JBoss, and Apache, including application hosting, configuration, reverse proxy settings, ports, certificates, service restarts, and basic Java application troubleshooting.

• **Cloud and infrastructure:** Work with GCP resources and approved hybrid infrastructure patterns involving compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, SSL/TLS, storage, and connectivity.

• **Automation:** Create and maintain Terraform configurations, Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell or PowerShell scripts for repeatable operational tasks and standard process execution.

• **Observability and performance:** Use Datadog or equivalent tools to review metrics, logs, dashboards, alerts, health checks, and performance indicators; identify trends and escalate abnormal conditions.

• **Incident and ITSM support:** Resolve routine and moderately complex incidents, participate in incident and change processes, maintain knowledge articles and runbooks, and escalate issues with clear evidence and impact details.

• **Project delivery:** Support infrastructure and application activities for assigned projects, deployments, testing, environment readiness, and operational handover.

• **Continuous improvement:** Identify opportunities to improve reliability, patch compliance, monitoring, recovery readiness, documentation, and standard operating procedures.

• **Collaboration:** Work effectively with D&T, network, OS, security, application, and vendor teams while sharing operational knowledge and following platform standards.

• **Support Requirement:** Participate in extended off-hours shift coverage, including overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Education:** Full-time graduation in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

• **Experience:** Minimum 6 years of total IT experience, including at least 4 years supporting infrastructure or enterprise application platforms in production and business-critical environments.

• **GCP and infrastructure:** Hands-on experience with GCP services, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, load balancers, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, networking, and access management.

• **Automation and scripting:** Practical experience with Terraform, Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, or PowerShell for operational support, configuration, validation, and automation.

• **Middleware and platform administration:** Working experience with IIS, JBoss, and Apache across Windows and Linux platforms, including configuration, troubleshooting, patching, service management, and application integration.

• **Operating systems and databases:** Working knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, relational database concepts, and applications using Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.

• **Monitoring and operations:** Experience with Datadog or equivalent observability tools, incident handling, patching, operational documentation, and root-cause investigation.

• **ITSM and collaboration:** Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service request, escalation, and knowledge-management practices, with strong stakeholder communication skills.

• **Core proficiency:** Ability to manage assigned tasks effectively, troubleshoot methodically, work across teams, and build new technical skills continuously.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Cloud breadth:** Exposure to AWS or Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud platform.

• **Delivery practices:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, DevOps practices, and release or deployment automation.

• **Project methodology:** Understanding of project delivery methods, including the Advantage project management methodology.

• **Continuous improvement:** Applies analytical thinking and AI capabilities where they provide business value to improve support, operations, and productivity.

• **Professional behaviors:** Demonstrates accountability, initiative, reliability, integrity, teamwork, learning agility, and a positive service mindset.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

IP Technologies and Protocols: Knowledge of the features and policies of IP technologies and protocols; ability to configure, deploy and support IP-based networks and services.

Troubleshooting Network Problems: Knowledge of tools and techniques to troubleshoot network problems; ability to anticipate, recognize and resolve technical (network, hardware, software, equipment or operational) problems.

Universal Competencies



Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.

title: Sr. Infrastructure Engineer – eApps
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

• Lead the engineering, operation, and continuous improvement of infrastructure supporting third-party Enterprise Applications (E-Apps), with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) as the primary cloud environment.

• Own hands-on infrastructure engineering across cloud and hybrid environments, including secure design, provisioning, migration, deployment, capacity, reliability, and lifecycle management.

• Drive Infrastructure as Code and automation using Terraform as the primary tool, supported by Ansible, Python, and Shell scripting; use PowerShell where required for Windows administration.

• Partner with solution teams, Enterprise Applications stakeholders, security, network, and service teams to define hosting standards, technical specifications, operational readiness, and support models.

• Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and promote standardization, observability, ITSM discipline, and secure-by-design practices across the E-Apps platform.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

• **Operate and continuously improve** the E-Apps infrastructure estate, including availability, performance, capacity, resilience, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and platform lifecycle management.

• **Design and provision GCP infrastructure** using approved architecture and security patterns across compute, networking, IAM, load balancing, DNS, certificates, logging, monitoring, storage, and secrets management.

• **Build reusable Terraform modules and deployment patterns** and develop Ansible playbooks, Python utilities, and Shell scripts to eliminate manual work and improve deployment consistency.

• **Administer and troubleshoot web and application platforms** including IIS, JBoss, and Apache, with understanding of Java application hosting, reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS offload, certificates, ports, and application integrations.

• **Implement observability and operational insight** using Datadog and GCP monitoring/logging capabilities, including dashboards, metrics, logs, traces, alerting, health checks, service-level indicators, and actionable runbooks.

• **Apply ITSM practices** across incident, problem, change, service request, knowledge, and major-incident management; maintain accurate operational documentation and participate in governance and change reviews.

• **Act as a senior escalation point** for outages, complex incidents, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, security findings, and recovery activities; drive permanent corrective actions.

• **Establish standards and governance** for configuration, access, automation, monitoring, vulnerability remediation, backup, recovery, and operational readiness of new and existing applications.

• **Mentor team members and coordinate support coverage** while promoting knowledge sharing, effective handoffs, and continuous improvement across the platform team.

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Education:** Full-time bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related technical discipline from an accredited university.

• **Experience:** 8–12 years of experience designing, implementing, operating, and supporting complex infrastructure and enterprise application environments, including high-availability and mission-critical systems.

• **GCP — primary requirement:** Strong hands-on experience with GCP services and architecture, including Compute Engine, VPC networking, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, SSL certificates, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Secret Manager, storage, and hybrid connectivity.

• **Terraform — primary engineering keyword:** Demonstrated experience creating maintainable Infrastructure as Code, reusable modules, environment configuration, state management, policy controls, and automated provisioning at scale.

• **Scripting and automation:** Strong Shell scripting and Python experience for operational tooling, integrations, validations, remediation, and workflow automation; practical experience with Ansible for configuration management and application/platform automation.

• **Web and application infrastructure:** Hands-on understanding of IIS, JBoss, and Apache administration, configuration, troubleshooting, patching, reverse proxying, Java application hosting, SSL/TLS, certificates, load balancers, and integration with enterprise applications.

• **Observability:** Good hands-on experience with Datadog and/or equivalent observability platforms, covering monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, alerting, synthetic or endpoint checks, and incident correlation.

• **ITSM and operations:** Working knowledge of ITSM practices and operational controls, including incident, problem, change, service request, major-incident, SLA, knowledge-management, and root-cause-analysis processes.

• **Systems and troubleshooting:** Working knowledge of Linux and Windows Server, networking fundamentals, firewalls, DNS, identity/access, relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL, and vendor-supported enterprise applications.

• **Leadership:** Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage competing priorities, communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders, and mentor junior engineers.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• **Cloud breadth:** Working knowledge of AWS and Azure administration; GCP remains the primary cloud requirement for the role.

• **Delivery practices:** Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, release automation, DevOps practices, and secure software delivery.

• **Platform experience:** Experience supporting SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, vendor-built applications, cloud migrations, and hybrid enterprise environments.

• **Certifications:** GCP, Terraform, Ansible, ITIL, or other relevant cloud and infrastructure certifications are desirable.

• **Continuous improvement:** Ability to use AI capabilities where they deliver business value and improve support, operations, and user productivity.

• **Leadership behaviors:** Demonstrates ownership, initiative, integrity, constructive challenge, collaboration, and an engaging leadership style; develops people and drives initiatives from idea through execution.

  

**SUPPORT REQUIREMENT**

• The role requires extended off-hours coverage, including overnight, weekend, and holiday on-call support on a weekly rotational basis, aligned to US business-hours support needs and the team’s operational support model.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Regional Project Development Manager for Reciprocating Compressors
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

We are seeking a Compressor Regional Project Development Manager (RPDM) for Reciprocating Compressors with a background in reciprocating compressors and proven understanding of driven/driver equipment and related auxiliary systems. This role is part of our dynamic regional service Modernization and Upgrades team in Asia Pacific.

Within the Asia Pacific region, we are supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors. You will be working closely with the regional Client Manager/mechanical & controls RPDM and be responsible for the technical solution as well as the techno-commercial proposal for developed compressor upgrade solutions.

This highly networked role requires the ability to work under pressure and meet ambitious deadlines, along with strong people management.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Actively and methodically explore the market to generate new leads and opportunities.
* Qualify opportunities for compressor upgrades, working with client managers to develop prospects and secure orders.
* Collaborate with the Controls Project Development Managers, CM, Service Centers to bring value propositions and navigate complex environments.
* Lead client communication such as technical presentations on rotating machinery M&U solutions and Siemens Energy's value propositions.
* Establish and maintain relationships with technical key decision-makers and influencers within client organizations, developing new client relationships through active engagement.
* Provide technical product training for regional teams, representatives, agents, and clients as required.
* Meet M&U targets and earning objectives, ensuring a clean handover to execution team.

* Develop regional technical and commercial proposals in alignment with customer requirements, defining the commercial according to organization’s policies and rules (Price, payment term, T&C’s etc)

* Prepare and issue Request for Quotations to the relevant major sub-suppliers in support of Siemens Energy bundled “extended scope" solutions) e.g. for site scans, cable laying, foundations, etc.)
* Work closely with various departments within the organization to collect the necessary information for preparing quotations for extended scope projects (such as site execution, repair center activities, installation, commissioning, and performance testing).
* Conduct site surveys, including preparation, execution, data collection, risk assessment, and report generation, for designated compressor upgrade projects to identify potential execution risks and establish a sequence of activities for execution.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical or equivalent experience in Engineering with demonstrated ability in rotating machinery in the energy industries, with extensive knowledge in rotating machinery (compressors).
* Minimum 6 years’ experience in reciprocating compressor field service, technical sales, proposals,commissioning Engineer or related work experience.
* Understanding of customer focused equipment and related auxiliary system control upgrade needs, with the ability to inform the factory about upgrade requirements and explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams across organizational and international boundaries, with a strong and confident presence in front of Siemens Energy and client personnel.
* Self-motivated with high energy drive and business sense, with a good understanding of driven/driver rotating equipment design and thermodynamic principles.
* Experience with Siemens Energy’s rotating machinery products is preferable, along with an understanding of competition's products and offerings.
* Willingness to travel when needed, with the ability to present and discuss technical solutions effectively via Microsoft Teams.

**About the Team**

Our **Transformation of Industry** division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 98,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy *https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo*

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure

description:
**DESCRIPTION**

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. * Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post-mortems, root cause analysis and follow-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best-in-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)

* Develop and deliver the regular engineering reports and ensure adherence to contracted deliverables including SLA’s and KPI’s.
